decisions.reason: It fits the firm's strategy of combining traditional woodcraft with technology, but the electronic feature and church-specific motif make it somewhat more niche and complex than core items.
A wooden nativity stable sits squarely in the firm's established seasonal handcrafted décor range and is likely to remain a dependable core product.
The modern incense smoker figurine is close to the existing offer and supports the move toward contemporary designs, though as a newer style variant it carries some portfolio-pruning risk.
